title: Auth Service Worker Pods Crashing (OOMKilled)
description: Auth-service pods are crashing cyclically with exit code 137 (OOMKilled). User sign-ins failing intermittently.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Unbounded session cache memory leak introduced in deploy v3.1.0 (deployed 6 hours ago), causing RSS memory to steadily climb until hitting the 2GB container limit.
key_evidence: Memory metric shows steady linear upward trend from 25% at 10:00 UTC to 98% at 15:50 UTC
Deploy v3.1.0 deployed at 10:00 UTC with commit 'Add in-memory user session cache'
Logs show OutOfMemory / cgroup killer invocation
distractors: Minor frontend static asset deploy at 15:52 UTC (v1.0.9 by web_team) right before pod crash

logs.message: v3.1.0 initialized session cache with TTL=0 (unbounded)
Deployed frontend v1.0.9: updated button color
Container killed by kernel: OOMKilled cgroups limit reached

auth-service.author: backend_dave@orange.com
auth-service.commit_message: Add in-memory user session cache without eviction policy

web-frontend.author: ui_sarah@orange.com
web-frontend.commit_message: Change checkout button color to blue
